days.brief: Split the day 4-4 and still lost 14.44u. The three MLB losses were two shutouts and a blowout - read failures the gate has to catch earlier. The WNBA lesson was pure math: massive minus prices risk a lot to win pennies, and one overtime loss at -1011 cost more than six times what both WNBA wins paid. Chalk sizing rules tightened from this day.

days.label: Tuesday, Sep 29
days.brief: 2-3, -7.19u. The morning read found no qualifying edge, and at 7:24 AM PT the site said no card. Later that morning five picks went up by owner directive, before the first game, with a sub-bar disclosure on the card. The card showed the model on each: Braves 64.3%, Maple Leafs 51.7%, Bruins 51.1%, Yordan Alvarez two-plus hits 31.3%, Abushaar 26.5%. Only the Braves sat inside the 60% band, and the Braves won; of the four below it, only the Bruins won. Five picks on one day are too few to judge owner-directed picks, so the day is graded on results and no read conclusion is drawn.

picks.name: Braves ML
picks.learning: Carded by owner directive after the morning read found no qualifying edge. The card put the model at 64.3% against a 64c price: inside the 60% band, but with almost no edge over the price. Won 5-3 over the Phillies for +2.81u. A win at a price that matches the model shows the result, not an edge.

picks.name: Yordan Alvarez over 1.5 hits
picks.learning: Carded by owner directive after the morning read found no qualifying edge. The card put the model at 31.3% for two or more hits against a 27c price (+270), a long shot far below the 60% band. Alvarez went 1-for-4 and Houston lost 6-3 to the White Sox. At 31% this misses about seven times in ten, so one miss says little either way.

picks.name: Loai Abushaar ML
picks.learning: User-directed pick carded by owner word at disclosed sub-bar economics (net -0.9c after fee) lost -5.0u. Provenance: owner-carded, not engine-certified. One fight is one outcome data point on the override class - no read conclusion drawn from it.

picks.name: Maple Leafs ML

picks.name: White Sox ML

days.label: Thursday, Oct 1
days.brief: 3-1, +3.93u. The Devils (3-2 in OT), Aces -4.5 (won by 11) and Mammoth (6-0) won; Under 38.5 lost, with Steelers-Browns going for 51. This card was built by hand outside the system's process: no fair values recorded, prices that were not the Kalshi ask, a Las Vegas team (the Aces) and a 6u stake that is not on the ladder. It ran on Instagram only, at 8:03 AM PT before the first game, while the site said no official picks; the row was filed a day late and kept by the owner's ruling. Its 'Yesterday 2-0, Overall 6-4' line was wrong too (it was 1-0 and 21-11). The Vegas rule and the ladder are now hard stops in the card builder.

picks.name: Devils ML
picks.learning: Won 3-2 in overtime over the Flyers for +3.09u. No fair value or pre-game notes were recorded for this hand-built card, and its -162 price matched sportsbook pricing, not the Kalshi ask. The win is real, but without a recorded fair there is no read to grade it against.

picks.name: Under 38.5
picks.learning: Lost: Browns 27, Steelers 24, 51 points against a 38.5 total. Staked 6u, a size that is not on the ladder; at the ladder's 5u it would have lost 1u less. The -115 was a sportsbook price while Kalshi offered about -108, and no fair value was recorded.

picks.name: Aces -4.5
picks.learning: Won 94-83, covering by 6.5 for +4.55u, but it should not have been carded: the Aces are a Las Vegas team, and the standing rule keeps Vegas teams off the card on either side. The -4.5 line was not a Kalshi market either. A rule break that wins is still a process failure; the card builder now refuses Vegas-team picks.

picks.name: Mammoth ML
picks.learning: Won 6-0 over the Blackhawks for +2.29u. The -218 card price was not the Kalshi ask: Kalshi's ask that morning was 67c, about -203, so the card showed a worse price than was available. No fair value was recorded, so the win grades the result, not a read.

Results: Under 6.5 W, Under 3.5 W, Over 43.5 W, Under 54.5 L.

picks.name: Under 3.5
picks.learning: Added after the final by owner override (result known at posting); the owner's own position, not a pre-game pick. Won: SD 2 @ ORL 1, 3 goals vs 3.5. The red team had killed it pre-game: Orlando's last four under its interim coach all went over the model. One result does not validate a killed pick.

picks.name: Over 43.5
picks.learning: Added after the final by owner override (result known at posting); the owner's own position, not a pre-game pick. Won: PSU 13 @ NU 34, 47 points vs 43.5. The red team had killed it: only 0.09c over the bar on a hand-set number, 15 mph wind, market moving down. A hand-set edge that wins is still not an edge.

picks.name: Under 54.5
picks.learning: Added after the final by owner override (result known at posting); the owner's own position, not a pre-game pick. Lost: PITT 35 @ VT 33, 68 points vs 54.5. The red team had killed it: the edge rested on hand-set scoring means from 2-3 games each; regressed, it fell under the band. No fair without a real sample.

Both NHL Over 4.5 totals lost at 4 goals, after the red team had flagged the NHL totals model as running about 3c high. Results: Rays ML W, White Sox +1.5 W, Padres +1.5 W, Lightning ML W, Kraken-Oilers Over 4.5 L, Capitals-Lightning Over 4.5 L.
